Theme

Nature & food

sprout noun

a young shoot

also shoot, bud

classical

germen, germinis n.

noun, third declension

sprout, shoot, bud

English germ and germinate derive from this vocabulary. Older dictionaries propose different deeper etymologies; no disputed Indo-European derivation is asserted here.

Other words

  • pullus, pullī m. — young animal or young shoot

    noun, second declension · also used · classical

Examples

  • Germen ē terrā oritur.

    A sprout comes out of the earth.composed

See also sprout.
